claude.namespaceEvidence: package/cli.js: q$(A) replaces [^a-zA-Z0-9_-] with underscore; IC(server) returns mcp__${q$(server)}__; va8(server,tool) appends q$(tool).
claude.protocolEvidence: Repo packages/adapters/claude-local/src/ui/parse-stdout.ts assistant.message.content tool_use IDs and user.message.content tool_result tool_use_id/is_error/content; official https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp documents MCP namespace.
claude.qualifiedShape: Top-level assistant tool_use correlated once to top-level user tool_result; exact AoA JSON success envelope in one text block or string; explicit/malformed is_error denied; nested parent_tool_use_id ignored.

gemini.qualifiedShape: tool_use(tool_id,tool_name mcp_aoa_<canonical-name>,dots preserved); tool_result(tool_id,status success,error absent,output string exact AoA JSON envelope). Output is joined MCP text, not structuredContent. Aliases over63 characters undercount instead of reverse guessing truncated names.

opencode.qualifiedShape: run JSON emits tool_use only for terminal part.type tool/state completed or error, never pending/running. part.tool aoa_<canonical sanitized [^a-zA-Z0-9_-] to underscore>; completed state.output flattened MCP text exact AoA JSON success envelope; metadata.truncated is emitted boolean and must be false.
opencode.limitation: OpenCode strips raw MCP isError while flattening content. Bridge emits success:false or plain denial/error text for failed/denied calls; those are rejected. No claim for arbitrary inconsistent raw MCP result whose content says success:true but stripped isError says true, nor unverified OpenCode versions.

auditBounds.collisionPolicy: Use full AoA registry plus allowlist, reject ambiguous sanitized aliases and any alias whose prefix could belong to delivered connector server. No raw arguments/results/URLs copied to toolsCalled.
